Apple And Salesforce Announce New Ios Partnership -- MarketWatch 9/24/18 9:39 AM ET (MarketWatch) Print
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) and Salesforce.com Inc. ( CRM ) on Monday announced a new enterprise partnership that will make it easier for iOS developers to design for Salesforce. Ahead of the Salesforce Dreamforce conference, Salesforce said that it would resign its app to add new exclusive iOS features. There will also be a new iOS app development course on Salesforce's educational Trailhead platform that will help Salesforce developers better operate in Apple's ecosystem. Apple shares are up 0.2% in Monday morning trading, while Salesforce's stock is off 0.6%. Shares of Apple have gained 43% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average , of which Apple is a component, has risen 19%.
-Emily Bary
